description: Validate a tagged canonical / design doc. Units are CLAIMS. The claim-discipline lives here as data (not in the shell): tag vocabulary, hypothesis-falsifiability, citation-verification, and the pass condition. The how-to-judge is prose in the steps this points to.

rules.desc: no untagged assertion. Sub-bullets inherit the parent claim's tag.

rules.requires: a stated falsification criterion (how it could be proven wrong, or an explicit 'unproven')
rules.desc: a hypothesis that cannot fail is not a hypothesis; it is an unmarked assumption.

rules.requires: verdict == confirmed AND authority set AND evidence set
rules.desc: external claims are fetched and confirmed against their authority, never assumed. Unreachable -> unresolved; source does not support the claim -> unsupported.
an in-repo path that resolves nowhere is a finding. A [[wikilink]] to a recognized external namespace (memory) is recorded as external and is NOT a finding.

authorities.citation: the cited work itself: arXiv id / DOI / publisher page
authorities.fact: the live source of truth: the site, dataset, standard, or registry the fact belongs to
authorities.path: the repository tree for in-repo paths; the memory namespace is a recognized EXTERNAL namespace (real, recorded, not gated as in-repo)

pass: no unit flagged: every claim tagged, every hypothesis falsifiable, every external claim confirmed, every in-repo reference resolved
